problem.title: SuMa KITTI Odom seq 01 full (1101 frames): ground pixels without forward information
problem.question: Does removing the forward component of ground-like pixels (ground_no_forward_vertical_cos=0.866, not in the paper) change full-sequence accuracy of the official SuMa defaults on raw scans?

variants.label: SuMaPaper, official defaults on raw scans (fresh reference)
variants.intent: Unchanged paper_odometry setting, rerun on the same binary as the candidate.
variants.note: SuMa paper pipeline (SuMaPaper: rendered surfel model, projective frame-to-model ICP, surfel stability and fusion per RSS 2018 / official default.xml); raw scans, no GT seed, no loop closure. frame-to-frame fallbacks=107
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.

variants.label: SuMaPaper + ground pixels without forward information (not in the paper)
variants.intent: Same setting; pixels whose model normal is within 30 deg of vertical give no forward information. Opt-in, default off; chosen on development sequences 01/02.
variants.note: SuMa paper pipeline (SuMaPaper: rendered surfel model, projective frame-to-model ICP, surfel stability and fusion per RSS 2018 / official default.xml); raw scans, no GT seed, no loop closure. frame-to-frame fallbacks=42; opt-in ground pixels without forward information, vertical cos=0.866000 (not in the paper)
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.
